subject: HIN
label: Grade 04
task: Meet the outcome of every unit in Grade 04 Hindi, and keep one piece of evidence for each.
condition: A 36-week school year, 4 units, a teacher or guide, a learning book or device, and local examples in the local language first with English support.
standard: Each unit: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school. Course pass: no unit at 'Not yet' after one retry, and a pass in SA1 and SA2.

modules.title: Verbs and tenses introduction
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Verbs and tenses introduction', taught in a way that is short, playful, with objects, pictures and talk. The target is clear: use simple verbs. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Verbs and tenses introduction' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.
Use it: use simple verbs, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
modules.example: Solved: main khata hoon (I eat), maine khaya (I ate), main khaunga (I will eat). Method: Model run for 'Verbs and tenses introduction'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 20 to 30 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: one page in your learning book.
modules.standard: Use simple verbs: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school.
steps: Step 1, A verb tells an action. Learn five: खाना [to eat], पीना [to drink], पढ़ना [to read], खेलना [to play], जाना [to go]. Remove ना to get the stem: खा, पी, पढ़, खेल, जा. Say each stem and each full verb.

Step 2, Make the present tense: stem + ता, ती or ते, plus है, हूँ or हैं. मैं स्कूल जाता हूँ। [I go to school, a boy speaking.] मैं स्कूल जाती हूँ। [A girl speaking.] वह खेलता है। [He plays.] हम पढ़ते हैं। [We read.]

Step 3, Make the past with जाना. कल मैं स्कूल गया। [Yesterday I went to school, a boy.] कल मैं स्कूल गई। [Yesterday I went to school, a girl.] हम बाज़ार गए। [We went to the market.] The ending shows gender and number.

Step 4, Make the future. कल मैं स्कूल जाऊँगा। [Tomorrow I will go to school, a boy.] कल मैं स्कूल जाऊँगी। [A girl.] हम बाग़ में खेलेंगे। [We will play in the garden.] Practise the same sentence in the three tenses.
Step 5, Fix an error. A child says मैं स्कूल जाता है। Correction: मैं स्कूल जाता हूँ। because मैं goes with हूँ. Another says वह खेलती हूँ। Correction: वह खेलती है। because वह goes with है.

Step 6, Your turn: say what you do today, did yesterday and will do tomorrow with पढ़ना. Model answer: आज मैं किताब पढ़ता हूँ। कल मैंने किताब पढ़ी। कल मैं कहानी पढ़ूँगा। [Today I read a book. Yesterday I read a book. Tomorrow I will read a story.]

modules.title: Opposites and word meanings
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Opposites and word meanings', taught in a way that is short, playful, with objects, pictures and talk. The target is clear: use opposites. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Opposites and word meanings' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.
Use it: use opposites, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
modules.example: Solved: bada-chhota (big-small), din-raat (day-night), garam-thanda (hot-cold). A synonym for 'sundar' is 'khoobsurat'. Method: Model run for 'Opposites and word meanings'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 20 to 30 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: one page in your learning book.
modules.standard: Use opposites: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school.
steps: Step 1, Opposites (विलोम शब्द) mean the reverse. बड़ा–छोटा [big–small], ऊँचा–नीचा [high–low], गर्म–ठंडा [hot–cold], दिन–रात [day–night], आगे–पीछे [front–back]. Read each pair, then cover one word and say its opposite.

Step 2, More pairs. अंदर–बाहर [inside–outside], सच–झूठ [truth–lie], हँसना–रोना [to laugh–to cry], मीठा–कड़वा [sweet–bitter], नया–पुराना [new–old]. Make a pair card for each, with the word on one side and its opposite on the other.

Step 3, Use opposites in sentences. यह पहाड़ ऊँचा है और वह टीला नीचा है। [This mountain is high and that mound is low.] चाय गर्म है, पानी ठंडा है। [The tea is hot, the water is cold.] दिन में रोशनी होती है, रात में अँधेरा। [There is light in the day, darkness at night.]

Step 4, Match meaning with context. बच्चा अंदर है, बिल्ली बाहर है। [The child is inside, the cat is outside.] मीठा आम और कड़वा करेला [sweet mango and bitter gourd]. Use each pair in one sentence about a picture.

Step 5, Fix an error. A child says the opposite of दिन is शाम. Correction: the opposite of दिन is रात; शाम is only part of the day. Adjectives must still agree: बड़ी मेज़ [big table] and छोटी कुर्सी [small chair], not बड़ा मेज़.

Step 6, Your turn: write the opposites of नया, अंदर and हँसना, then a sentence. Model answer: पुराना, बाहर, रोना। नया बस्ता पुराने बस्ते से अच्छा है। [Old, outside, to cry. The new bag is better than the old bag.]

Which action verb starts the outcome of Unit 1 (Verbs and tenses introduction), and at which Bloom level is it?
When do the formative checks FA1 to FA4 and the summative checks SA1 and SA2 happen?
FA1 to FA4 around weeks 6, 12, 24 and 30; SA1 in week 18; SA2 in week 36.
In which weeks does Unit 4 (Speaking practice) run?
What evidence do you keep for each unit, and why?
One page in your learning book. It shows what you can really do and lets a teacher check it against the standard.
ladder: L1: say and read familiar words and short sentences.
L2: read short texts and write connected sentences.
L3: write paragraphs and speak on a topic with notes.
L4: write for different purposes and analyse how texts persuade.
L5: write and argue at length; handle unseen texts.
L6 (degree): academic reading, writing and citation.
L7 (postgraduate): publish, teach or translate with expert accuracy.
